facts.event: 两个月过去、盛夏已尽，秋猎开始；Tilde 自陈自偷得一吻后众人皆装作无事。
facts.relation: Tilde 与 Elise 的隐秘情愫；宫廷集体沉默
facts.anchor: Two months, and the great heat of summer had passed, so began the autumn hunts.

facts.event: Merovin 策马与 Tilde 并行，点明她收下了 Widdin 公爵派来的护卫，并劝她闩好门。
facts.relation: Merovin 与 Tilde 的试探性同盟
facts.anchor: I see you accepted the guard from the ducal of Widdin.

facts.event: Tilde 派 Ziyan 给被鞭打的农奴送药膏与买布养伤的钱；Marolyn 监刑后不再以旧眼光看她。
facts.relation: Tilde 与农奴、Marolyn 的关系裂痕
facts.anchor: I had sent Ziyan to her with ointment, coin for her cloth and recovery.

facts.event: 猎队出猎，Low Priest Aeswyth 高呼勿深入林中；Elise 告诉 Tilde 只有雄鹿禁猎、雌鹿归她们。
facts.relation: Elise 与 Tilde 在猎场上的默契
facts.anchor: ‘Do not go deep into the woods!’ Low Priest Aeswyth was calling.

facts.event: Tilde 追雌鹿一矛落空（鹿被 Ysel 一组射倒），随后在谷中抢先掷矛，正中野猪侧腹。
facts.relation: Tilde 与 Cynghal 诸王子同场竞猎
facts.anchor: My strike slammed true into the boar’s side and it cried out

facts.event: Conrin 当众讥讽 Isen 怯懦、要女人收尾，Gundobar 附和；Isen 提剑下谷，Tilde 由此认出 Odon 即 General Nefka——曾在 Nandenys 城下指点少年将军折磨孩童。
facts.relation: Odon 的真实身份；Conrin 与 Isen 的兄弟敌意
facts.anchor: ‘I told you he was too cowardly,’ said Conrin to Gundobar and Gaisa

facts.event: Isen 冲上夺回 Tilde 的矛刺穿猪鼻，再一剑深插入颈杀死野猪，随后跪地以头触地，称它‘lord of the wood’。
facts.relation: Isen 与 Tilde 由敌意转为短暂敬意
facts.anchor: The boar ran, tearing both out of the prince’s hands, but it only made it two steps, three, before it collapsed

facts.event: 猪群惊奔冲垮山谷，Isen 被踩死；Conrin 被 Gundobar 拽住佯装救人却露出笑意，Alar 警告 Tilde‘Not all swans survive’，章末林中出现披狼皮、颈挂 Wing 银坠的男人。
facts.relation: Alar 对 Tilde 的威逼利诱；Conrin 的弑兄嫌疑
facts.anchor: The noise of pigs’ squealing drowned Isen’s into nothing
